events.title: ECMAScript 2024 standardized
events.summary: Ecma adopted ECMAScript 2024 in June 2024 — adding `ArrayBuffer` transfer, `Object.groupBy`, `Promise.withResolvers`, and `String.prototype.isWellFormed`.
events.about: ES2024 brought grouped collections and better async primitives to everyday JavaScript. `Promise.withResolvers` simplified hand-rolled promise patterns; grouping helpers reduced lodash usage for data aggregation in browsers and Node.

narrative.whyChosen: ES2024 added grouping and promise utilities developers reach for constantly.
narrative.whyImportant: Native grouping reduced dependency on utility libraries for common data tasks.
narrative.problemSolved: Grouping arrays and objects required manual loops or external helpers.

events.title: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet released
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet on June 20, 2024 — outperforming Claude 3 Opus on coding, reasoning, and vision at lower cost.
events.about: Claude 3.5 Sonnet set new benchmarks for AI-assisted coding and Artifacts (live previews). It competed head-to-head with GPT-4o and became the default model for many developer tools and enterprise chat products.

narrative.whyChosen: Claude 3.5 Sonnet was a mid-cycle leap that reset coding-assistant expectations.
narrative.whyImportant: A smaller, cheaper model beating flagship tiers changed how teams pick LLMs.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers needed frontier coding quality without flagship-model latency and cost.

events.title: Huang: more you buy, more you save
events.quoteText: The more you buy, the more you save. That's called CEO math. It's not accurate, but it is correct.
events.summary: At COMPUTEX 2024, Huang argues GPU clusters save money versus CPU-only AI infrastructure — then jokes about the logic.
events.about: The quip went viral: Huang's pitch that accelerated computing cuts total cost of ownership even as customers buy more GPUs. Tech press dubbed it 'CEO math' — half meme, half serious TCO argument that fueled NVIDIA's trillion-dollar valuation narrative.

narrative.whyChosen: The most quoted Jensen Huang line of the AI boom years — meme and sales pitch in one.
narrative.whyImportant: It encapsulated how NVIDIA sold scale-up clusters to hyperscalers and enterprises.
narrative.problemSolved: Buyers needed a simple story for why bigger GPU bills could mean lower cost per AI workload.
